profiles.title: Server profiles
profiles.subtitle: Keep multiple installations (modpacks, versions and worlds) on the same server and switch between them.
profiles.saveCurrentHint: Stop the server to save a copy of the current installation.
profiles.emptyHint: Save the current installation or create a new profile from the catalog.
profiles.saveModalDesc: A full copy of the active folder (modpack, config and world) will be stored.
profiles.activateConfirm: If the server is running, it will be stopped, its Docker container will be recreated for this profile, and the server will restart automatically. The current installation will be kept as a profile.
profiles.activateConfirmStopped: The Docker container will be recreated for this profile. The server will stay stopped until you start it. The current installation will be kept as a profile.
profiles.deleteConfirm: Permanently delete this profile and all its data (mods, config and world)?
profiles.newModalNote: The current installation will be archived as a profile and a fresh empty world will be created for this modpack.
